raw_segments.text: Well, whatever my sufferings had been, they were very short, I answered, and then I proceeded
to tell him how I had been received at Morehouse, how I had obtained the office of school mistress
and see the accession of fortune, the discovery of my relations, followed in due order.
Of course, St. John River's name came in frequently in the progress of my tale.
When I had done, that name was immediately taken up.
